statement: Adhi Yoga (Jupiter, Venus, and/or Mercury occupying the 6th, 7th, or 8th house from the Moon) is traditionally read as carrying leadership and authority, described in Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra as producing a commander, minister, or ruler, along with good health and relative freedom from open enemies.
editorial_note: Reflects a widely-repeated interpretation found throughout standard Vedic astrological literature, exemplified by (not claimed as a verbatim quotation of) the cited source.
